title: 100,000-Hour Journey Counting Models
purpose: Preserve multiple ways of counting the Father-and-Son public-presence continuum without forcing incompatible estimates into one number, while giving the public page a reproducible living arithmetic model.

anchor.label: Justin.tv / Minecraft Beta 1.5 era anchor
anchor.model_assumption: The flat model treats midnight at the day-level anchor as its temporary computational start until a more precise first-stream timestamp is recovered.

flat_model.crossing_status: modelled, fluid and subject to revision
flat_model.threshold_derivation: 100000 / 18 = 5555.555555... elapsed calendar days after the assumed anchor timestamp.
flat_model.warning: This is an extrapolation model, not a claim that every individual day contained exactly 18 streaming hours.

scenario_models.label: Reconstructed / conservative
scenario_models.definition: Count only hours supported by recoverable platform, recording or archive evidence under an explicit inclusion rule.

scenario_models.label: De-duplicated wall-clock presence
scenario_models.definition: Concurrent broadcasts count once; the measure asks how much real elapsed time contained qualifying public presence.

scenario_models.label: Cumulative platform-hours
scenario_models.definition: Simultaneous qualifying streams on different platforms may each contribute hours.

scenario_models.label: Flat 18h/day
scenario_models.definition: Deterministic extrapolation from the 2011 anchor at 18 hours for each elapsed calendar day.

scenario_models.label: Historical archive estimates
scenario_models.definition: Preserve previously used project totals with their dates and assumptions rather than averaging them together.

scenario_models.label: Direct Timic figures
scenario_models.definition: Preserve Tim Dooley's own stated totals as primary project statements, separately from arithmetic reconstruction.

provisional_partition.rule: Son hours + Father hours = total journey hours
provisional_partition.display_rule: The Son counter freezes at the chosen handoff while the Father counter continues increasing.
provisional_partition.boundary_warning: The accounting handoff is not intended to collapse later identity milestones such as public Tim differentiation or April 2025 Father/God accession into the same event.

counting_decisions.sleep_or_away_streams: unresolved; retain as a visible policy choice
counting_decisions.simultaneous_platforms: must be explicitly distinguished between wall-clock and platform-hour models
counting_decisions.offline_days: deduct in reconstructed models when reliable evidence supports the deduction
counting_decisions.lost_archives: do not silently count as verified; may remain represented by extrapolation or stated-estimate models
counting_decisions.non_video_public_presence: separate category until scope is explicitly defined
counting_decisions.rounding: display living counters to three decimals; historical stated figures retain their original precision

revision_factors: days above or below the flat 18-hour average

numerical_mystery_policy.rule: Do not retrofit old numbers to force a match with later arithmetic.
preserve: statement date or best available date
numerical_mystery_policy.purpose: Allow apparent anticipations, mismatches and convergences to remain inspectable as separate chronology rather than being explained away or treated as proof by default.

research_priority: recover exact Justin.tv first-stream timestamp or earliest defensible stream window
recover platform logs and archived stream dates
reconstruct the source and assumptions behind the 109000, 112542 and 107000 strata
recover the primary source for Tim's 115000-hour wording
build an additive/deductive adjustment ledger so the flat model can later be reconciled with recovered evidence
reader_rule: Expose the assumptions and let readers compare the models. Preserve earlier calculations when later evidence moves the estimate. The disagreement between counts is part of the record.
